_note: An example retro, invented to show the page: no real team or company. Build it with a settings file whose workshop is "retro" (tests/golden/retro.config.json is one).

went_well.text: Pairing designers with developers from day one meant fewer surprises at review.
Testing with screen reader users in week one caught the focus order problems early.
The new component library saved time on the payment form.
Daily stand-ups stayed under ten minutes.

got_in_way.text: The payment provider's sandbox was down for two days.
Requirements for saved cards changed in the second week.

questions.text: How might we keep working when a third-party sandbox goes down?
How might we lock requirements before the sprint starts?

ideas.text: Keep a recorded mock of the payment API so we can test offline.
A short requirements sign-off before sprint planning.
Ask the provider for an uptime alert we can subscribe to.
Add a screen reader check to the definition of done.

actions.what: Record a mock of the payment API for local testing.
Add a screen reader check to the definition of done.
Trial meeting-free Wednesday mornings for a month.
